origin_preview.experience: Learn the workshop lanes, assemble a relic build and defeat the Foreman Engine.
origin_preview.threat_preview: Scrap swarms, charging hounds and delayed ranged pressure introduce the pilgrimage.
origin_preview.optional_preview: Optional press, furnace and bell work grants immediate run rewards.

clear_memory.title: THE PARTS THAT CHOSE ONE ANOTHER
clear_memory.text: Your arm remembers a waterworks. Your bell remembers a factory. Neither remembers being asked to become a weapon.
clear_memory.conclusion: The Foreman is silent. Two roads answer the repaired workshop.

routes.name: Brass Choir Relay
routes.description: Fight through broken signals and moving escorts, then defeat the Choir Regent.
routes.threat_preview: Choir Drones disrupt weapon rhythm while Hounds and Cinder Spitters pressure open lanes.
routes.optional_preview: Optional relay tuning grants Scrap; defeating the boss is enough to proceed.
routes.news: Ada-9 heard three bells answer one another. None kept the same time.
routes.risk: Frayed warning wire crosses an exposed north road. Structure or Scrap may pay the toll.

wave_profiles.name: OUT-OF-TIME ESCORT
wave_profiles.pressure: Choir drones hold distance while Hounds test the open lanes.

wave_profiles.name: DELAYED REFRAIN
wave_profiles.pressure: One Cinder Spitter writes a delayed beat through a mixed escort.

wave_profiles.name: BROKEN PROCESSION
wave_profiles.pressure: Hounds close the road while a single ranged line denies stillness.

wave_profiles.name: THE REGENT'S MEASURE
wave_profiles.pressure: The Regent slows weapon cycles while its Choir screens the final relay.

objective.name: TUNE THE THREE RELAYS
objective.description: Optional: Stand inside a relay ring after clearing nearby hostiles. Progress persists. Each station grants +3 Scrap; defeat the boss to proceed.

pressure.name: REGENT RESONANCE
pressure.description: The Regent periodically slows every weapon cycle; move first, then endure the toll.

travel: The workshop lamps become three small stars behind you.
Bell wire crosses the road. Every loose bolt hums before the wind arrives.
The Choir Relay answers with a note too orderly to be welcoming.

road_nodes.name: The Warning Wire
road_nodes.news: The wire rings before anything moves. Ada-9's report was accurate.
road_nodes.risk: Crossing untreated costs 12 Structure; careful splicing costs 2 Scrap.

choices.label: Splice the warning wire
choices.description: Spend 2 Scrap and leave a working alarm for the roadside workshops.
choices.result: The wire learns one honest note.

choices.label: Cross beneath the ringing
choices.description: Keep your Scrap. Loose cable tears 12 Structure from the chassis.
choices.result: The Saint crosses before the third false alarm.

road_nodes.name: Ada-9's Waycart
road_nodes.news: A hand-painted sign offers repairs, bearings, and news in that order.
road_nodes.risk: Repairs consume the same Scrap needed at the next workshop.

choices.label: Buy a road repair
choices.description: Spend 4 Scrap to restore 22 Structure.
choices.result: Ada-9 tightens every bolt that still believes in threads.

choices.label: Buy the Choir timings
choices.description: Spend 1 Scrap. Carry Ada-9's warning into the destination record.
choices.result: Three bad timings become one useful warning.

choices.label: Keep moving
choices.description: Spend nothing and preserve the current build.
choices.result: Ada-9 salutes with a wrench.

memory.title: MEMORY / THE BORROWED BELL
memory.text: Your bell remembers warning workers before a furnace opened. It was built to preserve choice, not demand obedience.
memory.conclusion: The north road carries your repaired signal. The Choir heard a bell ring without permission.

routes.name: Rootworks Pump
routes.description: Break a sustaining machine line around the exposed pump, then defeat the Factory Heart.
routes.threat_preview: Repairing Rust Pilgrims sustain Mites and heavy Forklift Brutes around narrow service lanes.
routes.optional_preview: Optional pump work grants Scrap; defeating the boss is enough to proceed.
routes.news: Morrow found wet footprints made by machines that have no feet.
routes.risk: Flooded iron hides a damaged culvert. Safe bracing costs Scrap; wading costs Structure.

wave_profiles.name: GRAFTED HANDS
wave_profiles.pressure: Rust Pilgrims sustain a light scavenger screen around the exposed pump.

wave_profiles.name: LOAD-BEARING LINE
wave_profiles.pressure: Forklift Brutes shove the Saint away while Pilgrims repair each opening.

wave_profiles.name: SALVAGE FEVER
wave_profiles.pressure: Mites strip loose Scrap behind a slow line of grafted repairers.

wave_profiles.name: THE HEART'S QUOTA
wave_profiles.pressure: The Factory Heart calls repairers behind a final heavy work line.

objective.name: STABILIZE THE WATER PUMP
objective.description: Optional: Work inside the pump ring. The repair persists even when the roots force you away. Each station grants +3 Scrap; defeat the boss to proceed.

pressure.name: GRAFTED RECOVERY
pressure.description: The Heart calls a Rust Pilgrim to sustain the crowd until the pump is stable.

travel: The road sinks until old pipes become handrails.
Warm water clicks beneath the plates. Something below keeps trying to repair the road.
A pump coughs once in the dark, then waits for your answer.

road_nodes.name: The Flooded Culvert
road_nodes.news: Warm water rises around a brace cut with the Workshop's old mark.
road_nodes.risk: Bracing the crossing costs 3 Scrap; forcing the ford costs 10 Structure.

choices.label: Brace the old crossing
choices.description: Spend 3 Scrap and leave the culvert safer than you found it.
choices.result: The old brace takes weight again.

choices.label: Wade through the warm water
choices.description: Keep your Scrap. The flooded iron costs 10 Structure.
choices.result: Water drains from the Saint in patient red lines.

road_nodes.name: Morrow's Tinker Cart
road_nodes.news: Morrow has heard the pump answer machines that never learned its name.
road_nodes.risk: Repairs consume destination Scrap; selling the spare valve gives up a useful part.

choices.label: Commission a field patch
choices.description: Spend 4 Scrap to restore 20 Structure.
choices.result: Morrow seals the chassis with a strip of old boiler prayer.

choices.label: Sell the spare valve
choices.description: Gain 4 Scrap and record the part left behind.
choices.result: The cart keeps the valve; the Saint keeps moving.

choices.label: Keep the spare valve
choices.description: Spend nothing and preserve the current build.
choices.result: Morrow marks the low road clear.

memory.title: MEMORY / THE WATERWORKS ARM
memory.text: Your repair arm remembers closing a valve while the factory order said to keep production moving. Someone chose the town over the schedule.
memory.conclusion: Water returns by the low road. The Rootworks learned that a graft may keep its own purpose.

routes.name: Pale Archive
routes.description: Survive an ordered archive that copies your visible geometry, then defeat the Archivist Prime.
routes.threat_preview: Ranged screens and repairers constrain movement while the Archivist copies an evolved shape.
routes.optional_preview: Optional record recovery grants Scrap; defeating the boss ends this route.
routes.news: The index lists your components separately and leaves the line for your name blank.
routes.risk: The glass road audits names and ownership. Scrap can correct the record; an uncorrected passage costs Structure.

wave_profiles.name: OPEN CATALOGUE
wave_profiles.pressure: Choir Drones screen the first record while one delayed blast denies stillness.

wave_profiles.name: CORRECTION HANDS
wave_profiles.pressure: Repairers preserve the wrong entries while ranged pressure follows the index path.

wave_profiles.name: THE PRIME COPY
wave_profiles.pressure: The Archivist copies a visible evolved geometry and redacts the next record station.

objective.name: RECOVER THE UNFILED INDEX
objective.description: Optional: Recover the three records in their numbered order. Each accepted record persists. Each station grants +3 Scrap; defeat the boss to proceed.

pressure.name: INDEX REVISION
pressure.description: The Archive copies visible geometry and pressures the next record in sequence.

travel: The Choir road narrows between cabinets too large to have been carried here.
Glass labels turn as you pass. Each offers a different name for the same small machine.
The Pale Archive opens the drawer marked ERROR and waits.

road_nodes.name: The Misfiled Gate
road_nodes.news: A brass reader insists the Saint belongs to three owners who are all dead.
road_nodes.risk: Correcting the ownership plate costs 2 Scrap; forcing the gate costs 9 Structure.

choices.label: Correct the ownership plate
choices.description: Spend 2 Scrap and enter under the name you carry now.
choices.result: The reader files one living machine under itself.

choices.label: Pass under the closing gate
choices.description: Keep your Scrap. The glass audit takes 9 Structure.
choices.result: The gate records the damage as proof of entry.

road_nodes.name: The Margin Clerk
road_nodes.news: A many-jointed clerk trades repairs for annotations the Archive refuses to hold.
road_nodes.risk: A field repair consumes destination Scrap; preserving both costs nothing.

choices.label: Commission a margin repair
choices.description: Spend 4 Scrap to restore 20 Structure.
choices.result: The clerk stitches the chassis and cites no authority.

choices.label: Keep your own record
choices.description: Spend nothing and continue with the current build intact.
choices.result: The clerk leaves a blank margin for your return.

memory.title: MEMORY / THE BORROWED LENS
memory.text: Your lens remembers three owners and none of their names. It kept what they chose to notice, not what the index permitted.
memory.conclusion: The Archive keeps your blank line. You leave with every borrowed purpose still attached.

routes.name: Red Foundry
routes.direction: EMBER ROAD / THE FURNACES REFUSE NIGHT
routes.description: Keep moving through live furnace lanes, then defeat the Red Cardinal.
routes.threat_preview: Cinder marks and heavy frames close space while the Cardinal ignites furnace anchors.
routes.optional_preview: Optional furnace venting grants Scrap; defeating the boss ends this route.
routes.news: Red-13 says the foundry can still make anything, provided nobody asks what it costs.
routes.risk: The ember road crosses a live slag channel. Cooling it costs Scrap; crossing hot costs Structure.

wave_profiles.name: BANKED EMBERS
wave_profiles.pressure: Cinder Spitters mark the floor while one heavy frame narrows the escape route.

wave_profiles.name: SHIFT CHANGE
wave_profiles.pressure: The active vent changes while repairers hold a heavy production line together.

wave_profiles.name: THE CARDINAL'S QUOTA
wave_profiles.pressure: The Red Cardinal ignites furnace anchors and calls fresh cinder pressure.

objective.name: VENT THE THREE FURNACES
objective.description: Optional: Only the amber-lit vent accepts work. Its signal rotates, but progress persists. Each station grants +3 Scrap; defeat the boss to proceed.

pressure.name: FURNACE QUOTA
pressure.description: The Cardinal marks furnace anchors, then closes the current work lane.

travel: Soot settles on every repaired seam and makes the Saint look newly assembled.
The road warms beneath the tracks. A shift whistle sounds without workers.
Three furnace doors open together. Only one breathes cool air.

road_nodes.name: The Live Slag Bridge
road_nodes.news: The bridge opens only when the old cooling line believes a shift has ended.
road_nodes.risk: Priming the coolant costs 3 Scrap; crossing hot costs 11 Structure.

choices.label: Prime the cooling line
choices.description: Spend 3 Scrap and leave the bridge safe for the next pilgrim.
choices.result: Steam writes a brief white road across the slag.

choices.label: Cross before the whistle
choices.description: Keep your Scrap. Heat strips 11 Structure from the Saint.
choices.result: The Saint reaches the far rail smoking but upright.

road_nodes.name: Red-13's Ash Cart
road_nodes.news: Red-13 offers one patch, one rumour, and no explanation for the sparks.
road_nodes.risk: The patch spends destination Scrap; passing preserves every option.

choices.label: Buy the ash patch
choices.description: Spend 4 Scrap to restore 22 Structure.
choices.result: Red-13 welds by ear until the chassis rings true.

choices.label: Follow the shift whistle
choices.description: Spend nothing and preserve the current build.
choices.result: Red-13 points toward the only stack without smoke.

memory.title: MEMORY / THE BORROWED SHELL
memory.text: Your armour remembers shielding a worker who had missed quota. The plate was condemned for protecting the wrong asset.
memory.conclusion: The furnaces cool unevenly. The Red Foundry records mercy as an unauthorized material.

routes.name: Null Assembly
routes.description: Time movement and attacks through suppression fields, then defeat the Null Auditor.
routes.threat_preview: Choir screens and heavy displacement surround anchors that quiet relics only during optional work.
routes.optional_preview: Optional anchor work grants Scrap and briefly quiets relics; defeating the boss ends this route.
routes.news: No machine returns from the white road with the same list of permitted parts.
routes.risk: The white road inventories every component. A clean manifest costs Scrap; refusal costs Structure.

wave_profiles.name: PARTS INSPECTION
wave_profiles.pressure: Choir fields shelter scavengers around the first erasure anchor.

wave_profiles.name: REJECTION LINE
wave_profiles.pressure: Heavy frames displace the Saint from work while Mites strip the abandoned lane.

wave_profiles.name: THE AUDITOR'S BLANK
wave_profiles.pressure: The Null Auditor silences relic cycles and marks both anchors for erasure.

objective.name: DISABLE THE ERASURE ANCHORS
objective.description: Optional: Your relics fall quiet while you work inside an anchor ring. Leave to fight; return without losing progress. Each station grants +3 Scrap; defeat the boss to proceed.

pressure.name: PERMITTED PARTS
pressure.description: The Auditor suspends weapon cycles briefly and marks the active anchor.

travel: Root fibres end at a road scrubbed clean of footprints.
A gate inventories your arm, bell, lens and shell as four separate errors.
Inside, white lamps erase every shadow except yours.

road_nodes.name: The Inventory Arch
road_nodes.news: The arch counts four incompatible machines and permits only three.
road_nodes.risk: Filing a variance costs 2 Scrap; refusing inspection costs 10 Structure.

choices.label: File the fourth variance
choices.description: Spend 2 Scrap and make the impossible inventory official.
choices.result: The arch stamps ERROR, then opens anyway.

choices.label: Refuse the inventory
choices.description: Keep your Scrap. The closing arch costs 10 Structure.
choices.result: The Saint leaves four clean dents in the white gate.

road_nodes.name: The Nameless Bench
road_nodes.news: Tools wait in exact order beside a repair ledger with its owner removed.
road_nodes.risk: Self-repair consumes destination Scrap; moving on leaves the unknown tools untouched.

choices.label: Use the waiting tools
choices.description: Spend 4 Scrap to restore 20 Structure.
choices.result: The tools return themselves to an order no record names.

choices.label: Leave the bench unnamed
choices.description: Spend nothing and continue with the current build.
choices.result: The empty ledger keeps no debt.

memory.title: MEMORY / THE UNWRITTEN INSTRUCTION
memory.text: The assembly record ends before your first command. In the empty space, four incompatible machines chose to keep one another working.
memory.conclusion: The Null Assembly cannot name what left through its gate. The Saint keeps moving anyway.
